description: (Na)₂ErCuCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a ErCuCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the ErCuCl₆ framework, Er is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ErCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Er-Cl bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ErCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Er and one Cu atom.
